title: Trails · Swings, spells and spirals
description: Ribbon trails (src/trails.ts, docs/graphics.md) in a fight frozen in time and stepped frame by frame: Gerard's fist mid-swing and just after contact, a dog lunging, Foc Binari (two braided streams of fire from the raised hand), Cardioide and Análisis Parálisis flying to the party in Matemágico's gold, an ánima waking in three strands and a swap in two, and a comet thrown between fighters.

steps.eval: window.step = frames => { for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) window.gerard.game.app.fire('update', 1 / 60); }; window.play = (effect, frames, anima = 'matemagico') => import('/src/battle.ts').then(m => { const g = window.gerard.game; g.app.timeScale = 0; g.effects.clear(); g.setBattle(m.createBattle(2, 3, false, anima), effect); step(frames); }); window.models = () => { const stage = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Escenario de combate'); return stage.children.filter(c => c.enabled && !['Objetivo', 'Marca de tinta'].includes(c.name)).sort((a, b) => a.getPosition().x - b.getPosition().x); };

steps.caption: A plain attack: Gerard's fist swings an arc of warm light into the blow
At contact: the arc fades into the flash and sparks
A dog lunges: a streak behind its nose

steps.eval: play({ kind: 'skill', skill: 'foc-binari', actor: 'gerard', target: 'dog-1', burn: { id: 'quemado', level: 1 } }, 28)

steps.caption: Foc Binari: two braided streams of fire wind from Gerard's raised hand
Foc Binari lands: a 1, so the dog catches fire
An ánima wakes: three strands of its light wind up round him
A swap (L / R): two strands, quicker

steps.eval: play(undefined, 0).then(() => { const [a, , , d] = models(); const p = a.getPosition(), q = d.getPosition(); window.gerard.game.effects.comet({ x: p.x, y: p.y + 1.2, z: p.z }, { x: q.x, y: q.y + .7, z: q.z }, '#7fc8d8', .45, { arc: 1.2 }); step(16); })

steps.caption: effects.comet: a spell thrown in an arc between fighters
…flaring where it lands as its tail catches up
